notes.notes:
*Point system
-You can get points while playing the game, and use points to get beneficial effects at the start.
It's not very effective, but it will help.
I want to make the game so that anyone can clear it.

*Store theme music
-Music comes out when you approach the store.
It doesn't seem to match, but it's subtly attractive, so I decided to leave it.
